Ooredoo شريك رسمي للبطولة الوطنية «الأصا: Ooredoo official partner of the National «Al-Assayel» Purebred Arabian Horse Championship
وفاءً لالتزامها المتواصل بدعم الرياضة وا: True to its ongoing commitment to supporting Algerian sport and cultural heritage, Ooredoo Algeria is accompanying, as a sponsor and partner, the events of the second edition of the National «Al-Assayel» Purebred Arabian Horse Championship, which will be organized on October 16 and 17, 2026, at the National Equestrian Sports School in Blida.
سيجمع هذا الموعد الفروسي مربي الخيول وفر: This equestrian event will bring together horse breeders, riders, and equestrian enthusiasts, along with the public, in a competition dedicated to celebrating the purebred Arabian horse and contributing to the promotion of the national equestrian heritage.
تُشكل هذه الطبعة الثانية مناسبة جديدة لل: This second edition constitutes a new opportunity to celebrate the beauty, elegance, and authenticity of the Arabian horse, and to highlight the expertise and passion of the various stakeholders who contribute to preserving this ancient breed and developing equestrianism and horse breeding in Algeria.
من خلال مرافقتها للطبعة الثانية من بطولة: Through its support for the second edition of the «Al-Assayel» Championship, Ooredoo Algeria continues its support for initiatives aimed at promoting sports and cultural heritage by celebrating the purebred Arabian horse as a symbol of passion, excellence, and authenticity.
من جهة اُخرى، ستُسجل Ooredoo الجزائر حضو: On the other hand, Ooredoo Algeria will mark its presence at this championship alongside participants and visitors through a dedicated space designed to provide an interactive experience at the heart of this event. This space will allow visitors to benefit from various activities and discover Ooredoo's offers and services in an atmosphere combining entertainment, connectivity, and closeness to the public.
